previous_statement: Exact amplified formula, range, and involution. For every n, T_n:=I_n tensor T equals W_n composed with v_n, is linear with range in M_n tensor S^{A_R}_a, and satisfies T_n(x^dagger)=T_n(x)^dagger.
new_statement: Exact amplified formula, range, and involution. Put R_n=I_n tensor R and a_n=I_n tensor a. Tensor functoriality for linear maps and lem-compcb-amplified-compression applied first in A and then in A_R give I_n tensor T=Co^{A_R}_{a_n} composed with Co^A_{R_n} composed with v_n=W_n composed with v_n. The same external identifies M_n tensor S^A_P and M_n tensor S^{A_R}_a with the corresponding amplified compression ranges, so the displayed map is linear and has the asserted target. The extended t-isomorphism v preserves dagger exactly at every level. Applying lem-compcb-amplified-compression-identities to the square pairs (R_n,R_n) in A and (a_n,a_n) in A_R shows successively that both compressions preserve dagger. Hence T_n(x^dagger)=T_n(x)^dagger for every n and x.
